name: Intel Arc Pro B70 ARK specifications
notes: Intel ARK 403s on plain curl but serves the full spec table to web_extract. Prints 'GPU TFLOPS (FP32) 22.94', 'GPU Peak TOPS (Int8) 367', 'Memory 32 GB GDDR6', 'Graphics Memory Interface 256 bit', 'Graphics Memory Bandwidth 608 GB/s', 'TBP 230 W', 'Graphics Max Dynamic Clock 2800 MHz', 'Graphics Clock 2280 MHz'. NO per-pin memory data rate is printed - unlike the Arc B580 ARK page which does print 'Graphics Memory Speed 19 Gbps'. Intel's convention: ARK prints a single 'GPU Peak TOPS (Int8)' figure with no dense/sparse split and no sparsity footnote anywhere on the page.
